name: PersonaConvBench
description: PersonaConvBench is a large-scale benchmark designed to evaluate personalized reasoning and generation in multi-turn conversations with large language models. It integrates personalization and conversational structure across three core tasks—sentence classification, impact regression, and user-centric text generation—covering 10 diverse Reddit-based domains to analyze how personalized conversational context shapes LLM outputs.
typical_sota_score: varies by task; classification tasks often ~80–90% while regression/generation are evaluated with task-specific or human metrics
reputation: A recent benchmark for personalized conversational reasoning that is emerging in the LLM evaluation literature but is not yet broadly standardized.
notes: Focuses on personalized conversational context and multi-user scenarios; includes three core tasks and covers 10 Reddit-based domains.
